name: Aurecon Indigenous Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Annual scholarship for full-time Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UQ coursework students in financial need.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled full-time in any coursework program at UQ.
how: Apply using the online application form. One application covers the Aspire, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Education and UQ Residential scholarship schemes.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.

evidence.claim: Full-time coursework, Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander
evidence.quote: are enrolled full-time in any coursework program at the University of Queensland.
